text_block_list.text:
One day, right when our training is
winding
down...

I thought I could hang on until training
was over,
but it doesn't look like that's
going to be
possible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood, Trainer.

Reassured by her firm reply, I quickly
head to the
restroom.

An hour later, my stomach issues have
passed,
but I realize I forgot something
at the field. I head
back for it, only to
find...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Trainer.
Mihono Bourbon is still cooling down.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Your words implied that I should
cool down
until my heart rate returned
to a normal level.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You used the term "adequately." That is
an
adverb that means "sufficiently—not
excessively."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have been waiting here for
my heart
rate to sufficiently return to
so-called "resting"
levels...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am jogging and walking as part of my
cooldown
routine.

First of all, her heart rate's not going to
get to
resting levels if she keeps
jogging...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Measuring heart rate...  Forty beats per
minute
above "resting" rate... Continuing
cooldown.

After stopping Mihono Bourbon from
continuing
her "cool down," I make a
note to be clearer with
my instructions in
the future. A few days later...

Right when our training is winding down,
I receive
a message from Director
Akikawa.

"Attention all trainers! Emergency
meeting at
once!"

I'm still concerned about Mihono
Bourbon's last
misstep, but when
Director Akikawa says to meet,
she
means without delay.
I leave her a light training regimen with very specific numbers and leave the gym.

The next morning, I go to the gym to
check on
our training equipment...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. My training will
end in
precisely four minutes and two
seconds.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Last night, my training equipment was
damaged.
My attempts at repair were
futile, as my database
lacks any suitable
methods...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I requested assistance with repairs from
the
custodian at 8:00 a.m. this morning.
I was finally
able to resume training a
short time ago.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

Resisting the urge to faint, I explain
clearly that
it's okay for her to go home
when something like
that happens, and
send her back to her dorm.

I make that pledge to myself, and then a
few
more days later...

Right when our training is winding down,
I get a
message that a bird slammed into
my office
window and shattered it!
I'm still worried about the last two blunders with Bourbon, but... I've got to clean up the glass before anyone gets hurt.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong, Trainer?

I summarize the situation for her and
give her
instructions to follow for the
remainder of her
training session.

I add that I want her to do a
fifteen-minute
cooldown and then go
home after she's finished.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Instructions acknowledged. Proceeding
to the
academy perimeter.

Mihono Bourbon goes to the school
gate.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Two laps around the academy
perimeter
completed. Commencing
cooldown.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Fifteen minutes have elapsed. Shifting to
"go
home" phase. A job well done.

Mihono Bourbon follows my orders and
heads
back to her dorm, just as I told
her to!

Although there's glass scattered all over
my office
floor, I'm in rather good spirits.

I add that I want her to be conscious of
the
physical load she puts on each
muscle as she
trains.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Instructions acknowledged. I will
commence
strength training
immediately.

I pray that things go well this time and
hurry to
my office. On the way, another
trainer I know
calls out to me.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Um, I just saw Mihono Bourbon with a
whole
bunch of tires strapped to her... Is
she okay?
I hurry back to find a wild scene.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Sufficient abdominal load confirmed.
Resuming
strength training exercise
one—"sit-ups."

Sporting a serious expression, Mihono
Bourbon
continues her sit-ups with a
huge number of tires
strapped to her
waist.
